parts.title: Listening Passage 1
parts.transcriptHtml:
SCRIPT:

Hello? Jennifer speaking.

Hello Jennifer. My name’s Ben Smith. I’m from the New Zealand Post Office Service.

I understand you left a couple of questions on our website forum.

Seeing as though you left your phone number as a contact, I thought you might prefer us to call.

Oh Ben! Its nice to speak to you again. I really appreciate your help last month.

Yes, as I will be moving to Australia soon and need to send some of my things via airmail, I just wasn’t sure how to get my mail redirected.

I can help you with that.

It’s interesting that I recently got more inquiries about international mailing due to migration to other countries. May I ask why you are moving?

Umm. . . There are a few reasons such as I have family in Australia and the weather there is warmer, but mainly because it hard to find a job here .

I have just got the news that I was successful in applying for a job in Australia! I’ll be starting in November.

How exciting, congratulations! I have never been to Australia, but I’ve heard it’s a nice place. Is it a permanent job?

No, I will only be working for that company as a temporary assistant over this summer .

You never know I might get homesick and want to come back after a few months anyway!

I hope the job goes well for you. What postal address will you be using in Australia?

I had organized some accommodation at a hostel in Sydney for the first week,but that fell through, so I will stay at my friend’s house until I find somewhere else. My things will have to be sent to her place for now and the address is 9 Queen Street, Sydney .

Can I know how long you will be staying there? We want to make sure you get your mail while you are there.

I will be staying there for the first two months . You know, it’s free staying with her.

That’s nice! Now, I’ve got a couple more questions for you. What is your full name and current address?

My name is Jennifer Simmons.

How do you spell your surname, please?

It’s S-I-M-M-O-N-S .

Got that. And your address, please?

Oh, right. I’m currently living at 16 Ocean Road, Auckland .

And your postcode?

It’s 0245.

That doesn’t come up in our system as a valid postcode. Can you check that again, please?

Yes, sorry! I’m not good at remembering numbers. It’s 0425.

When would you like your things to be air mailed?

I will leave New Zealand on the 23rd of September, but I will try to send them on the 22nd .

so that’s the day before. How long will it take for my things to get to Australia?

It will take about a week.

Perfect. That should give me time to get organized in Australia before everything arrives.

May I ask about the content of your delivery?

There are some things you have to sign a goods declaration for, such as expensive items or if you are importing medications in bulk.

I won’t be sending anything like that. It’ll mainly be personal items. I was thinking of posting some books.

But I guess that’s quite expensive because they are heavy. And my guitar is kind of big.

Yes, it can be quite expensive.

Ummm. . . I might not send them then. I definitely need to send some of my files .

I have one standard-size file box full of them.

Sure. Anything else?

I’ve heard the beaches and the ocean are beautiful in Australia. I enjoy diving so I’m going to send my diving gear as well .

I have packed it into a box to send it more easily. Would you mind if I weighed everything and sent you information to get a quote on the price?

Just send it to info@postalservice.nz. Can I help you with anything else?

No, that’s everything. Thank you for your help!

Yes, as I will be moving to Australia soon and need to send some of my things via airmail, I just wasn't sure how to get my mail redirected.

I can help you with that.

It’s interesting that I recently got more inquiries about international mailing due to migration to other countries. May I ask why you are moving?

{Umm. . . There are a few reasons such as I have family in Australia and the weather there is warmer, but mainly because it hard to find a job here ][1]}.

I have just got the news that I was successful in applying for a job in Australia! I'll be starting in November.

How exciting, congratulations! I have never been to Australia, but I've heard it's a nice place. Is it a permanent job?

{No, I will only be working for that company as a temporary assistant over this summer ][2]}.

You never know I might get homesick and want to come back after a few months anyway!

I hope the job goes well for you. What postal address will you be using in Australia?

I had organized some accommodation at a hostel in Sydney for the first week,{but that fell through, so I will stay at my friend's house until I find somewhere else. My things will have to be sent to her place for now and the address is 9 Queen Street, Sydney ][3]}.

Can I know how long you will be staying there? We want to make sure you get your mail while you are there.

{I will be staying there for the first two months ][4]}. You know, it's free staying with her.

That’s nice! Now, I've got a couple more questions for you. What is your full name and current address?

My name is Jennifer Simmons.

 

How do you spell your surname, please?

{It's S-I-M-M-O-N-S ][5]}.

Got that. And your address, please?

{Oh, right. I'm currently living at 16 Ocean Road, Auckland ][6]}.

And your postcode?

{It's 0245.

That doesn't come up in our system as a valid postcode. Can you check that again, please?

Yes, sorry! I'm not good at remembering numbers. It's 0425 [7]}.

When would you like your things to be air mailed?

{I will leave New Zealand on the 23rd of September, but I will try to send them on the 22nd ][8]}.

so that's the day before. How long will it take for my things to get to Australia?

It will take about a week.
